policy.base: same-seed original H1; never no-B model
policy.form: if same actual pose returnH1; nonfinite/missing returnH1(reason); otherwise switch iff max(zH1)-max(zR)>0 AND sH1(h)-sH1(r)<=tau
policy.group_split: freeze label-free verified source scene/sequence/asset provenance and deterministic hash split approximately2:1; adjacent/repeated/symmetry representations connected; uncertain independent groups=>INTERNAL_POLICY_CHECK_UNAVAILABLE
policy.shared_asset_note: shared asset reported; scene independence needs actual generator/sequence provenance, no arbitrary per-frame ID as independence proof
policy.threshold_candidates: all unique finite development gaps plus NEGATIVE_INFINITY
development_constraints: nonidentity and at least one strict mean or large-error improvement
policy.confirmation: one application of chosen tau on held groups, same nonworsening conditions; failure=>identity no second search
policy.unavailable_internal_check: identity adopted; preserve any exploratory full-validation thresholds/trial as diagnostic only
